title: EYP Türkiye Mersin 2026 - Ulusal Seçme Konferansı (National Selection Conference)
description: National Selection Conference of EYP Türkiye, the Turkish national committee of the European Youth Parliament network — a youth civic-engagement/debate conference (committee work, general assembly, resolution debate) rather than a competition or project build.
selectivity_evidence: Described as a 'National Selection Conference,' implying delegates advance toward further EYP sessions via selection, but no published acceptance rate or selection mechanism found. Not claiming a selectivity_tier above open_enrollment without that evidence.
verification_status: Verified - official EYP Türkiye events page fetched directly, 2026-08-22, confirms the Mersin 2026 conference date. Application link listed as 'coming soon' at time of check, not yet live.
notes: AGE ELIGIBILITY NOT CONFIRMED: checked the EYP Türkiye homepage, an 'about' page (404), and the events page directly — none states a numeric age or grade requirement for delegates. EYP's international network commonly cites a 16-22 delegate range for some national committees (e.g. Germany's), but this is a different chapter and that figure was not found on any EYP Türkiye page, so it is NOT applied here — minimum_age/maximum_age left null rather than borrowed from a different country's chapter. Cost/fee also not stated anywhere found. A separate 'İstanbul 2026 (5th National Session)' with an open delegates call was mentioned on an earlier homepage fetch but did not appear with a distinct date on the events page on a follow-up fetch — recording only the Mersin 2026 conference, which had a consistent, independently re-confirmed date, rather than the one with a conflicting/unclear status between two fetches of the same site. SOURCE-AUTHORITY GATE FINDING: domain is eyp.org.tr — looksOfficial('eyp.org.tr') returns false (not .gov.tr, not .edu, not .ac.) despite being the organisation's own registered Turkish domain for a well-established pan-European youth civic organisation with an official Turkish national committee.

title: THIMUN The Hague 2027 Conference
description: Four-day Model United Nations simulation for secondary school students, run by the THIMUN Foundation at the World Forum Convention Center in The Hague, Netherlands. Approximately 3,200 students and teachers from roughly 200 schools worldwide attend annually. Registration is school-based: individual students apply through a participating school, not directly, except for a small set of named leadership positions (Student Officer, NATO, HSC, IC, ICES, Comité français, Press).
cost: EUR 340 per person (delegates, MUN-Directors, chaperones, most individual position holders), includes lunches and public transport during the conference
application_requirements: registration through a participating school (FORM I + non-refundable pre-payment)
selectivity_evidence: Selective by school capacity/participating-school registration rather than a published individual acceptance rate; not claiming a selectivity_tier above open_enrollment without a published rate.
verification_status: Verified - official THIMUN conference page fetched directly (2026-08-22) for the description, dates and Netherlands-based format; the EUR 340 fee, FORM I deadline (2026-09-25), and school-registration model cross-confirmed from the THIMUN 2026 Registration Handbook PDF hosted on the same official domain. 'For secondary school students' is the programme's own self-description, independently found via search of the official site's own conference page.
notes: No numeric minimum/maximum age or grade level is stated on any page or handbook excerpt checked — 'secondary school students' is the only eligibility language found, so age fields are left null rather than inferring a specific range (e.g. 14-18) from that phrase. No mention of financial aid/scholarships on any page checked, recorded as financial_aid_available=false based on its explicit absence across multiple official documents (registration handbook + conference page), not a null-for-unknown case. Individual (non-school) applicants can only apply for a small set of named leadership roles, not as ordinary delegates — flagged in description since this materially changes who can actually use this record: a student without a participating school cannot join as a delegate through this listing alone. Confirmed international schools are eligible (the handbook discusses visa applications and travel from outside the Netherlands). SOURCE-AUTHORITY GATE FINDING: domain is thehague.thimun.org, a plain .org — looksOfficial() returns false, same gate finding as the other records in this batch, this time against a well-established European MUN institution rather than a Turkish org.
